blurb: This classic, relaxing massage is one of our most popular techniques; it helps you fully unwind and get rid of daily stress and muscular tensions. For Swedish massage, our therapist uses a mixture of gentle gliding and kneading techniques to release overall body tensions, specific areas such as your head, neck and shoulders would get focused treatment.
